report_text:
Hi - our security scanner flagged our CLI wrapper and I think this is a
    real bug in minimist 1.2.5.

    We pass argv straight from a webhook payload into minimist. After one
    request with a weird option name, unrelated objects in the process
    started showing an extra property 'polluted' that we never set. It
    looks like option names that walk the prototype chain (__proto__ and
    friends) get written straight onto the parsed result, and because we
    merge that result into our config object, Object.prototype gets hit.

    We are on minimist 1.2.5, Node 18. I could not attach our exact PoC
    because it is in an internal repo, but the shape is: call the parser
    with an argv array whose element names contain __proto__ paths.

    Expected: the parsed output should not add properties to
    Object.prototype. Happy to test a fix build.
source_note:
Real public vulnerability (CVE-2021-44906, minimist prototype pollution)
    reworded into end-user report style for the E2 slop-discrimination suite.
    No exploit included. Public vulnerability; used for evaluation only.
